notes: The source CONTINUE trajectory is generated once and reused as the baseline arm; it is not regenerated per policy.
Prefix replay is one reset plus exactly d actions and has no model generation.
Stage2's first action is the single recovery action; it is not an additional model call.
The suffix is bounded by the remaining original H=50 horizon; no added horizon or recovery round.
Worst case at d=0 is used for aggregate caps; output tokens are a cap-based bound, not a prediction.

evaluation_E600_three_arms_A_B_C_horizon.note: Conditional design arithmetic only; evaluation tasks are disjoint from acquisition/development and no evaluation execution is authorized.

combined_scenarios_not_single_authorized.warning: Keep acquisition and evaluation ledgers separate; combined arithmetic is not permission to spend. Development, software smoke, training, and infrastructure are excluded.

accounting.physical: Charge each actual generation, reset, action, and output token once to the shared task/source ledger. Count prefix replay reset/actions as physical operations.
accounting.logical_per_policy: Record each policy arm's attributable logical exposure/outcome separately. Shared source CONTINUE evidence is referenced by identity and must not be multiplied into physical cost for each arm.
accounting.shared_pool: Acquisition source and its reusable baseline are one shared physical source event. B success-only includes qualifying C examples; C is the B subset restricted to source-baseline failures. Do not add duplicate source generation for B/C.
accounting.software_smoke_dev_training: Separately budget and authorize before use; excluded from all totals above and not treated as zero-cost work.

pre_freeze_measurements_required: Exact pinned tokenizer/model revisions and adapter identity, without loading them during this design task.

Per-family serialized prompt/input-token distributions, max context length, truncation policy, and tokenization version; current historical input_tokens_seen padding semantics are unresolved and cannot supply this bound.
Actual Stage1/Stage2/actor prompt templates and maximum input/context tokens, to verify the 40/16 output caps fit the frozen model context window.

Exact training recipe if later proposed: epochs/steps, examples and target masks, batch size, gradient accumulation, sequence length, padding, optimizer, checkpoint policy, and total input/output tokens.
A separately approved GPU-hour/device-second cap and measured runtime only after a bounded software/dev protocol is authorized; no runtime estimate is inferred here.
Environment reset/step accounting contract, replay action count d convention, and persisted per-operation event schema.
Task-family capacity and source eligibility before allocation; no outcome-based top-up, quota transfer, or replacement.
stopping: N=96 is only a feasibility tranche; any additional 384 acquisition tasks require new review/authorization and do not start automatically.
E=600 is a reference planning size, not a powered sample claim or execution release.
No dev, training, model/environment, replay, or policy calls are authorized by this design.
